articles.summary: Herc Holdings Inc. (NYSE: HRI), one of North America’s leading equipment rental suppliers operating through Herc Rentals Inc. (“Herc Holdings,” “Herc Rentals” or the “Company”), today announced it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results on October 27, 2026, before the market opens. The release will be followed by an investor conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET. On the call, management will review the Company’s results and may discuss or disclose material business, financial or other information that is not contained in the press release. A live webcast of the event will be available at: https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/383873427 The call will also be accessible using the following dial-in numbers: North America (Toll-Free): +1 833 461 5787 International (Toll): +1 585 542 9983 UK (Local): +44 117 389 0104 UK (Toll-Free): +44 808 196 8935 All dial-in numbers Meeting ID (required for call access): 383 873 427 Please dial in at least 10 to 15 minutes
articles.title: Herc Holdings Inc. Announces Date for Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Call and Webcast
